# Tasks: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Included. The constitution's RNF07 (`lib/**/domain/**` ≥80% coverage) and RNF09
(15/15 write-endpoint failure scenarios via `mocktail`) gates apply to this unit, and
quickstart.md's "Automated checks" section explicitly names the domain/data tests this unit's
coverage depends on — so test tasks are generated alongside implementation, matching
F000/RF03's existing `bloc_test`/`mocktail` style exactly.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US4, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P3). Per
contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, all four stories share one page/bloc
(`InsertionModalPage`/`InsertionModalBloc`) by deliberate design (research.md R6) — "independent"
here means each story's acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on their own
once Foundational is done, not that each story gets its own screen or bloc. `entries/` (research.md
R8) is built once in Foundational because all three capture modalities (US1–US3) depend on
`CreateEntryUseCase` to persist their result.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (text entry), US2 (audio entry), US3 (photo entry), US4 (abandoning a capture
  leaves nothing behind)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (F000/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure. All
new files live under `lib/features/entries/`, `lib/features/capture/`, `test/features/entries/`,
`test/features/capture/`, and one new `lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`; one existing
F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`) and the shared `service_locator.dart`/`pubspec.yaml`/iOS
project files are touched at documented extension points.

---

## Phase 1: Setup

**Purpose**: Dependencies and native-project changes every later task needs.

- [ ] T001 Add `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, `connectivity_plus`, and `path_provider` to `pubspec.yaml` dependencies (research.md R1–R5), then run `fvm flutter pub get`
- [ ] T002 [P] Add `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`, and `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` (three one-line usage strings) to `ios/Runner/Info.plist` — required before any mic/camera/gallery access is even attempted on-device or in the Simulator (research.md R1/R3)
- [ ] T003 Raise `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` from `15.0` to `15.6` across all three build configurations (Debug/Release/Profile) in `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` — `whisper_ggml`'s documented minimum (research.md R2)
- [ ] T004 [P] Bundle the `ggml-tiny` (quantized `q5_1` variant preferred for size) Whisper model asset under `assets/models/` and declare it under `flutter.assets` in `pubspec.yaml` — delivered as a bundled asset, never downloaded over the network, so on-device transcription stays network-independent from first launch (research.md R2)

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: The shared `entries` feature (the one sanctioned seam every capture modality creates
an entry through), the cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker`, and the Insertion Modal's
page/bloc/tab-bar shell every user story extends. No story's acceptance scenario can be exercised,
manually or in a test, until this phase is done.

**⚠️ CRITICAL**: No user story work can begin until this phase is complete.

### `entries` feature (research.md R8 — built once, depended on by US1/US2/US3)

- [ ] T005 [P] Create `Entry` entity plus its `EntrySource` (`manual`, `audio`, `photo` only for this unit — **not** `chat`, which is RF10's own addition), `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`), and `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) enums, and `EntryTag`/`PiiSpan` classes, in `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` — every field in data-model.md's table is `required` (the full `entries-create` response shape), including `content` (`String`, "1–20000 chars; the text this unit always supplies non-empty"), `chatMessageId` ("Always `null` for every entry this unit creates"), `tags` ("Always empty for a freshly created entry"), and `mediaDurationSeconds` ("This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null`")
- [ ] T006 Create the `EntriesRepository` abstract interface — `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source})` and `List<Entry> get cachedEntries` — in `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` (contracts/entries-repository.md) — depends on T005
- [ ] T007 [P] Create `CreateEntryUseCase` ("the one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry") in `lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart` — `call(String content, EntrySource source)` delegates straight to `repository.create(...)`; takes only `(content, source)`, no `chatMessageId` parameter (research.md R8 — RF10 will extend this signature, never bypass it) — depends on T006
- [ ] T008 [P] Write `CreateEntryUseCase` tests in `test/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase_test.dart` against a fake `EntriesRepository` (RNF07 gate): delegates with the exact `content`/`source` given; `Right(entry)` and `Left(failure)` both pass through unchanged — depends on T007
- [ ] T009 Create `EntriesRemoteDataSource` in `lib/features/entries/data/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — the only class calling `ApiClient.call('entries-create', method: 'POST', body: {'content': content, 'source': source.name})` and parsing the full `Entry` response shape; never sends `occurredAt`/`mediaDurationSeconds`/`chatMessageId` in the request body (contracts/entries-repository.md) — depends on T005
- [ ] T010 [P] Write `EntriesRemoteDataSource` tests in `test/features/entries/data/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` (mocktail, mocking `ApiClient`, matching `auth_remote_data_source_test.dart`'s existing pattern) — depends on T009
- [ ] T011 Create `EntriesRepositoryImpl` implementing `EntriesRepository` in `lib/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl.dart` — wraps `EntriesRemoteDataSource`, maps `DioException`/malformed bodies through the existing `ErrorMapper` unchanged, and owns the in-memory `List<Entry>` backing `cachedEntries` (appended to only on a successful `create()`, never read back out for display by this unit — FR-011) — depends on T006, T009
- [ ] T012 [P] Write `EntriesRepositoryImpl` tests in `test/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl_test.dart` covering the 3 failure scenarios for `entries-create` (timeout → `NetworkTimeoutFailure`, no connection → `NetworkOfflineFailure`, malformed response → `ValidationFailure` — data-model.md, toward RNF09's running 15-scenario total) plus the cache-append-on-success behavior — depends on T011

### Cross-cutting

- [ ] T013 [P] Create `ConnectivityChecker` in `lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart` — `Future<bool> hasConnection()` wrapping `connectivity_plus`'s `Connectivity().checkConnectivity()`, `true` unless the result is `ConnectivityResult.none` — lives in `core/`, not inside `capture/`, because later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) reuse this exact checker (research.md R5)

### Dependency injection

- [ ] T014 Register `EntriesRemoteDataSource`, `EntriesRepository` (as `registerLazySingleton` — one instance for the app's process lifetime, same pattern `VaultRepository` uses, so `cachedEntries` survives across modal opens), `CreateEntryUseCase`, and `ConnectivityChecker` in `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart` — depends on T009, T011, T007, T013

### Insertion Modal shell (shared by all three capture tabs)

- [ ] T015 [P] Create `CaptureTab` enum (`texto`, `audio`, `foto`) and the `InsertionModalEvent` sealed base with `TabSelected` and `ModalClosed` events in `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart` (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md)
- [ ] T016 [P] Create the `InsertionModalState` sealed base with `InsertionModalTexto(text)` — the initial state (`const InsertionModalTexto(text: '')`, FR-002's default tab) — in `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart`
- [ ] T017 Create `InsertionModalBloc` skeleton in `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_bloc.dart` — no `ModalOpened`/async-resolution event needed since the Texto tab's default state is static and synchronous (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md); handle `TabSelected(texto)` by restoring the bloc-private text draft, and a placeholder `ModalClosed` handler (extended by T065 in US4) — depends on T015, T016
- [ ] T018 [P] Create `CaptureTabBar` widget in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/capture_tab_bar.dart` — exactly three tabs ("Texto", "Áudio", "Foto") dispatching `TabSelected`, with the active tab visually distinguished ("MUST present exactly three capture modes as tabs... with the active tab visually distinguished" — FR-002) — depends on T015
- [ ] T019 Create `InsertionModalPage` skeleton in `lib/features/capture/presentation/pages/insertion_modal_page.dart` — rendered as an overlay above Home/Chat with a darkened scrim and a close control, without discarding Home/Chat's state underneath ("MUST provide an Insertion Modal... shown as an overlay above Home/Chat (with a darkened scrim) without discarding or navigating away from Home/Chat's state underneath" — FR-001); an exhaustive `BlocBuilder` switch over `InsertionModalState` (tab bodies filled in by later story tasks) plus a `BlocListener` that pops the sheet on the one-shot success side effect (FR-011 — no dedicated `InsertionModalSuccess` state needed, per contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) — depends on T017, T018

**Checkpoint**: Foundation ready — the `entries` feature, `ConnectivityChecker`, and
`InsertionModalPage`/`InsertionModalBloc`/`CaptureTabBar` shell all exist and are wired through DI.
User story implementation can now begin.

---

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Writing a journal entry as text (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Tapping "+" opens the modal on its Texto tab; typing non-empty text enables "Salvar";
tapping it creates exactly one entry with origin "manual" and closes the modal back to Home/Chat.

**Independent Test**: Tap "+", type text into the Texto tab, tap "Salvar", and confirm a new entry
with that exact text and origin "manual" now exists, and the modal has closed back to Home/Chat.

### Implementation for User Story 1

- [ ] T020 [P] [US1] Add `TextDraftChanged(text)` and `SaveTextSubmitted` events to `insertion_modal_event.dart` — depends on T015
- [ ] T021 [P] [US1] Add `InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)` and `InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, message)` states to `insertion_modal_state.dart` — depends on T016
- [ ] T022 [US1] Create `SaveTextEntryUseCase` in `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_text_entry_usecase.dart` — `call(text)`: `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false` → `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure(...))` *before* calling `CreateEntryUseCase` at all ("the system MUST block the Save action with a clear message rather than attempting a write that cannot succeed" — FR-010); else `CreateEntryUseCase(text, EntrySource.manual)` (save-usecases.md) — depends on T007, T013
- [ ] T023 [P] [US1] Write `SaveTextEntryUseCase` tests in `test/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_text_entry_usecase_test.dart` against fakes: offline → `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` without `CreateEntryUseCase` ever being invoked; `CreateEntryUseCase` failure passes through unchanged; happy path → `Right(entry)` with `source: manual` — depends on T022
- [ ] T024 [US1] Register `InsertionModalBloc` as a `registerFactory` in `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`, constructed with `SaveTextEntryUseCase` — depends on T022, T017, T014
- [ ] T025 [US1] Extend `InsertionModalBloc`'s constructor and implement `TextDraftChanged` (→ `InsertionModalTexto(text)`) and `SaveTextSubmitted` (ignored while `state is InsertionModalTextoSaving` — double-tap guard, Assumptions; else → `InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)`, await `SaveTextEntryUseCase(text)`, `Right(entry)` → one-shot success side effect, `Left(failure)` → `InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)`) — depends on T017, T020, T021, T022
- [ ] T026 [US1] Create `TextoTabView` widget in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/texto_tab_view.dart` — a free multiline text field and a "Salvar" action "that is unavailable while the field is empty" ("MUST provide a free multiline text field and a 'Salvar' action that is unavailable while the field is empty" — FR-003, enabled iff `text.trim().isNotEmpty`); renders the plain generic loading indicator (`DesignTokens.sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`) for `InsertionModalTextoSaving` and a plain failure message for `InsertionModalTextoFailure` — depends on T021
- [ ] T027 [US1] Wire `InsertionModalPage`'s Texto branch to render `TextoTabView`, and add a real, enabled leading `IconButton` ("+") to `_ComposerBar` in `lib/features/home/presentation/pages/home_chat_shell_page.dart`, opening `InsertionModalPage` via `showModalBottomSheet` wrapped in a fresh `BlocProvider(create: (_) => getIt<InsertionModalBloc>())` per open — a fresh bloc on every open is what satisfies FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction (research.md R9, contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) — depends on T019, T024, T026
- [ ] T028 [P] [US1] Write `InsertionModalBloc` tests in `test/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` for the Texto flow: empty-field `SaveTextSubmitted` is never reachable (enabled/disabled is a widget-level concern, verified in T026, but the bloc test confirms `TextDraftChanged` round-trips the draft correctly); `SaveTextSubmitted` success triggers the close side-effect and appends to `cachedEntries`; offline blocks before `CreateEntryUseCase` is ever called; a second `SaveTextSubmitted` while already `InsertionModalTextoSaving` is ignored (no duplicate entry — Edge Cases: "double-taps 'Salvar'... only one entry is ever created") — depends on T025

**Checkpoint**: User Story 1 is independently functional and testable — text capture works end to
end.

---

## Phase 4: User Story 2 - Recording a journal entry as audio (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Switching to the Áudio tab starts recording immediately with a waveform and timer;
tapping stop transcribes on-device and saves, producing one entry with origin "audio"; a
recognition/save failure never loses the recording and lets the user retry without re-recording.

**Independent Test**: Open the Áudio tab, record a short spoken note, stop the recording, confirm
Save completes, and confirm a new entry exists with origin "audio" and text content derived from
what was spoken.

### Implementation for User Story 2

- [ ] T029 [P] [US2] Create the `RecognitionFailure` sealed type (`EmptyRecognitionResult`, `TranscriptionError`) in `lib/features/capture/domain/entities/recognition_failure.dart` — local to `capture/domain/`, **not** added to `core/network/failure.dart`, since this is a purely local condition with no corresponding backend code (research.md R7)
- [ ] T030 [P] [US2] Create `AudioCaptureRepository` abstract interface (`hasPermission()`, `start()`, `amplitudeStream`, `stop()` returning the finished WAV file's path, `discard()`) in `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart` (contracts/audio-capture-repository.md)
- [ ] T031 [P] [US2] Create `AudioTranscriptionRepository` abstract interface (`Future<Either<RecognitionFailure, String>> transcribe(String audioFilePath)`) in `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart` — depends on T029
- [ ] T032 [US2] Create `AudioRecorderDataSource` in `lib/features/capture/data/audio_recorder_data_source.dart` — the only class importing `record`'s `AudioRecorder`/`RecordConfig`/`AudioEncoder` types, configured `RecordConfig(encoder: AudioEncoder.wav, sampleRate: 16000, numChannels: 1)` (research.md R1), exposing `onAmplitudeChanged(Duration)` as a `Stream<double>`
- [ ] T033 [US2] Create `AudioCaptureRepositoryImpl` implementing `AudioCaptureRepository` in `lib/features/capture/data/audio_capture_repository_impl.dart`, mapping everything to plain `bool`/`String`/`Stream<double>` before it reaches `domain/` (RNF06) — depends on T030, T032

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup (T004's bundled model asset is read by US2's T034) — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) should be done first — it is the only story with no recognition dependency, and it is
    the one that first registers `InsertionModalBloc` in DI (T024) and adds the real "+" button
    (T027), which US2/US3 build on.
  - US2 (P1) and US3 (P2) each extend the same `InsertionModalBloc`/`insertion_modal_event.dart`/
    `insertion_modal_state.dart`/`insertion_modal_page.dart` files US1 touches (T041/T059 both
    extend the bloc's constructor; T045/T062 both extend the page's `BlocBuilder` switch) — doing
    them in priority order (US2 before US3) avoids rework, even though each is independently
    testable once done, per spec.md's own priority ordering (P1 before P2).
  - US4 (P3) depends on US2's and US3's `*Recording`/`*Saving`/`*Captura` states already existing
    to have something to abandon (T065 extends the same `ModalClosed` handler T017 stubbed).
- **Polish (Phase 7)**: Depends on all four stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- Domain entities/enums before repository interfaces; repository interfaces before data sources
  and usecases; usecases before bloc wiring; bloc wiring before the tab-view widget that reads it;
  DI registration before the "+"/tab-selection path that resolves the bloc from `get_it`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can be run immediately after) each implementation task, per the
  file pairing above, rather than strictly before — this project's F000/RF03 precedent write/extend
  the same test file across a story's tasks rather than one file per task.
- Story complete (domain + data + bloc + widget + tests) before moving to the next priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T002, T004 (Setup) in parallel with T001/T003 once each is independently actionable.
- T005, T013 (entities/connectivity) in parallel within Foundational; T015/T016/T018 (event/state/
  tab-bar skeletons) in parallel with each other and with the `entries` feature tasks.
- T008, T010, T012 (test files) can be written in parallel with each other once their respective
  implementation task lands.
- T020/T021 (US1 bloc event/state additions) in parallel with T022/T023 (US1 usecase + its test) —
  different files, both depend only on Foundational.
- T029/T030/T031 (US2 domain types) in parallel with each other; T048/T049 (US3 domain types) in
  parallel with each other.
- T036/T038 and T054/T056 (test files) in parallel with their respective sibling implementation
  task's dependents once that task lands.

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
   criterion, SC-001).
4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
   structurally identical.
5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.
6. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.

---

## Notes

- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/
  insertion-modal-bloc.md chose (mirroring RF03's `VaultBloc`), not a same-file conflict to avoid.
- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`,
  **not** `Either<Failure, T>` — it has no network call and no corresponding backend code

  and reuses the existing `Failure` hierarchy unchanged.
- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, RF02's
  (not-yet-built) dedicated recognition-state screens, or any of RF04–RF10's behavior — all
  explicitly out of scope (FR-012, FR-013).
- `OcrResult.confidence` is carried through the full pipeline (T049, T055) but never branched on
  anywhere, including in the UI (T061) — confidence-based quality gating is explicitly RF02's
  concern (Clarification 3).

# Implementation Plan: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)

## Summary

RF01 gives Home/Chat's composer a real "+" button (F000 shipped none — research.md R9) that opens
a bottom-sheet Insertion Modal with three tabs: Texto (free text), Áudio (auto-starts recording on
tab activation), Foto (camera/gallery choice). Confirming Save — tapping "Salvar" for Texto,
tapping stop for Áudio, or supplying an image for Foto (research.md R6) — runs the minimal
recognition this unit owns (on-device Whisper transcription for audio, the backend's existing
`media-ocr` call for photo, per the spec's resolved Clarification) and then creates exactly one
journal entry through a brand-new `entries` feature's shared `CreateEntryUseCase` — the same seam
`requirements.md`'s RF10 text already names and will extend later, never bypass (research.md R8).
Recognition and the entry-creation call both show only a plain, generic loading indicator;
dedicated multi-state recognition screens, an editable review step, and modality-specific retry
affordances are explicitly RF02's to build, not this unit's (FR-007). An offline Save is blocked
before any network call is attempted, via a new cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` (research.md
R5) that later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) can reuse. No backend/contract change.

| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | All three tabs render from `design_tokens.dart`'s existing scale, no new token needed (research.md R10). The one deliberate fidelity carve-out — this unit's plainer failure/retry UI not reproducing the prototype's named "Erro" states — is explicitly sanctioned by spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1, not a new deviation (research.md R11). |
| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | `lib/features/entries/{data,domain,presentation}` (presentation unused by this unit's scope — no entries/-owned screen yet, intentionally left for RF07), `lib/features/capture/{data,domain,presentation}`. No domain type in either feature imports `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, or a `data/` class — contracts/*.md. |
| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | Every network call (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) reuses the existing >300 ms loading-indicator convention; the Áudio tab's "starts immediately" and the Texto tab's enabled/disabled toggle are both purely local, well under 100 ms. |
| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF01 | PII stripping and retention are backend-side policies on `entries-create`, unchanged by this unit; RLS is already enforced server-side on every call this unit makes. |
| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A to RF01 | Belongs to the Settings/RF09 unit. |
| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | `entries/domain/` and `capture/domain/` import no `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, or `data/` class — enforced by the same `always_use_package_imports`/`domain_purity_test.dart` convention F000 set up. |
| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | Every usecase in this unit (`CreateEntryUseCase`, `SaveTextEntryUseCase`, `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`, `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`) is a pure orchestration of injected repository interfaces, straightforwardly testable against fakes/mocks — see quickstart.md's test list. |
| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS, with one documented, spec-sanctioned carve-out | Texto/Áudio-Gravando/Foto-Captura rendered per prototype-extract.md §2.3; the audio/photo failure states are this unit's own plainer UI, not the prototype's named "Erro" states — see research.md R11 for why this is not a fidelity gap. |
| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PARTIAL BY DESIGN, not a violation | Consistent with F000/RF03's own note: RNF09's 15-scenario target (5 write endpoints × 3 failures) is reached incrementally across the delivery order. This unit contributes full timeout/malformed/offline coverage for 2 of the 5 write endpoints (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) — 6/15 scenarios, cumulative with F000's auth endpoints. `AudioTranscriptionRepository` deliberately does **not** return `Either<Failure, T>` (the backend taxonomy) — research.md R7, the same scoping precedent RF03's R5 already established for its own local-only repository. |

*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*

## Project Structure


### Source Code (repository root)

feature folders, one new `core/network/` file, and touches one existing F000 file at its
documented extension point.

(`features/entries/`, `features/capture/`, `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`) plus one
one-line-equivalent edit to an existing F000 file's composer widget — chosen over folding

addition for the bundled Whisper model, no change to `docs/`, `.specify/`, or prior units' spec
directories.

## Complexity Tracking

*No entries — every addition below is either one of the constitution's implicitly-open choices
(a device-capability package needed to implement a literal FR, same category as RF03's `crypto`)
or `whisper_ggml` itself, which Principle II fixes outright rather than leaving open.*

## Post-Design Constitution Check

Re-evaluated after Phase 1 (data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md):

- `EntriesRepository`/`AudioCaptureRepository`/`AudioTranscriptionRepository`/
  `PhotoCaptureRepository`/`PhotoRecognitionRepository` (contracts/*.md) all expose only domain
  types (`Entry`, `EntrySource`, `RecognitionFailure`, `OcrResult`, `PhotoSource`, plain
  `bool`/`String`/`Stream<double>`) — no `record`, `image_picker`, or `whisper_ggml` class crosses
  into `domain/`. RNF06/Principle V confirmed before any code exists.
- `EntriesRepository.create()` and `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` are the only two
  repositories this unit adds that return `Either<Failure, T>`, reusing F000's existing `Failure`
  hierarchy unchanged — no new `Failure` subtype needed, since `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` was
  already present from F000 and fits the illegible-image Edge Case exactly.
  `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`
  instead (research.md R7) — re-checked against RF03's own R5 precedent and found to be the same
  shape of decision, not a new kind of exception to RNF09.
- `CreateEntryUseCase`'s signature (`content`, `source` — no `chatMessageId`, research.md R8) was
  re-checked against RF10's exact requirements.md wording ("the chat feature triggers the creation
  of the entry through a shared interface / use case") and confirmed to satisfy it: RF10 will add
  a parameter to this one usecase, not build a second path into `EntriesRepository`.
- `InsertionModalBloc`'s state machine (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, data-model.md's
  transition tables) was re-checked against research.md R6 specifically for any accidentally
  re-introduced second "Salvar" tap for Áudio/Foto — none exists: stopping the recording and
  supplying an image are each the one and only confirming action for their modality.
- No change surfaced that touches `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, F000's
  `session_expired_overlay.dart`/re-auth path, RF03's `vault/` feature, or any AI provider —
  Principle III remains intact. The two native-project changes this unit makes
  (`IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`, three `Info.plist` strings) are both package-forced, not product
  decisions, the same category RF03's own `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` addition already set
  precedent for.

No new violations. Gate remains PASS.

1	# Data Model: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1, 6.2, 9 (data model reference), §13, and
4	`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas. This unit introduces
5	one new backend-shaped entity (`Entry`, read from a contract the backend already defines — no
6	schema change) and one ephemeral, device-only, non-persisted "entity" (Capture Session, modeled as
7	presentation state, not a domain type — see research.md R8 for why `Entry`/`EntriesRepository`
8	live in a new `entries` feature, separate from `capture`).
9	
10	## Entry (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`)
11	
12	The full shape of `POST /entries`' response — every field below is `required` in the OpenAPI
13	schema on every response, so none is optional to model (research.md R8).
14	
15	| Field | Type | Notes |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| `id` | `String` (uuid) | Server-assigned. |
18	| `content` | `String` | 1–20000 chars; the text this unit always supplies non-empty (FR-003/Edge Cases — never an empty/near-empty entry). |
19	| `source` | `EntrySource` | `manual` \| `audio` \| `photo` for this unit (see below — `chat` is RF10's addition). |
20	| `chatMessageId` | `String?` (uuid) | Always `null` for every entry this unit creates. |
21	| `occurredAt` | `DateTime` | Server-assigned; this unit never sends its own value in the request. |
22	| `tags` | `List<EntryTag>` | Always empty for a freshly created entry (tags are the manual-tagging extension, out of scope — requirements.md §2); modeled so later units reading an `Entry` don't need a second type. |
23	| `piiStatus` | `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; this unit does not branch on it. |
24	| `piiSpans` | `List<PiiSpan>` | As returned; not rendered by this unit. |
25	| `embeddingStatus` | `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; not rendered by this unit. |
26	| `mediaDurationSeconds` | `int?` | This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null` on the response to an entry this unit creates. |
27	| `serverRevision` | `int` | Opaque; not used by this unit. |
28	| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | — |
29	| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | — |
30	
31	```dart
32	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)
33	enum PiiStatus { pending, clean, flagged, failed }
34	enum EmbeddingStatus { pending, ready, failed }
35	
36	class EntryTag { final String id; final String name; }
37	class PiiSpan { final int start; final int end; final String type; }
38	```
39	
40	**Validation rule**: `content` is never sent empty or whitespace-only — enforced before any of the
41	three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
42	on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a
43	recognition failure, not forwarded to entry creation — Edge Cases).
44	
45	## `EntriesRepository` (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)
46	
47	```dart
48	abstract class EntriesRepository {
49	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});
50	  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;   // FR-011's "local entries store/cache" — in-memory, this process's lifetime
51	}
52	```
53	
54	- `create()` posts to `entries-create` via the existing, unmodified `ApiClient`/`Failure` hierarchy
55	  — no new `Failure` subtype (every backend error this call can realistically return —
56	  `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PII_CHECK_FAILED`, `EMBEDDING_FAILED`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`,
57	  `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `RATE_LIMITED` — already exists in `core/network/failure.dart`).
58	- `EntriesRepositoryImpl` is registered as a `get_it` `lazySingleton` (the same pattern
59	  `VaultRepository` uses for its own in-memory, process-lifetime state — RF03 research.md R3) so
60	  `cachedEntries` survives across modal opens/closes without a local database. On a successful
61	  `create()`, the returned `Entry` is appended to this in-memory list before the `Either` is
62	  returned to the caller. Nothing in this unit ever *reads* `cachedEntries` back out for display —
63	  it exists purely so RF07 (the first unit that reads entries for a screen) has something to read
64	  from day one, per FR-011's explicit forward reference to "Meus Registros, RF07."
65	
66	## `CreateEntryUseCase` (`lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart`)
67	
68	```dart
69	class CreateEntryUseCase {
70	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source) =>
71	      repository.create(content: content, source: source);
72	}
73	```
74	
75	The one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry (research.md R8) — `capture`'s
76	three save usecases below depend on this, never on `EntriesRepository` directly.
77	
78	## Capture Session (presentation-only state — not a domain entity, not persisted)
79	
80	Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the
81	Insertion Modal is open" — in this codebase's existing convention (mirrors RF03's "Presentation-
82	only state" section: `VaultMode`, the in-progress first PIN entry), this is `InsertionModalBloc`'s
83	own state plus two bloc-private fields, not a type any other layer sees:
84	
85	| Held where | What | Lifetime |
86	|---|---|---|
87	| `InsertionModalState` (public, see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's own idle/recording/saving/failure sub-state + the Texto draft text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open; discarded (never persisted) when the modal closes, satisfying FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction — a fresh bloc is created on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. |
88	| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The WAV file path `AudioCaptureRepository` wrote to, kept only so a failed transcribe-or-save can retry (FR-009) without re-recording. Cleared on successful save, on modal close, or on switching away from the Áudio tab (Edge Cases: switching tabs mid-recording discards it). | Same as above. |
89	| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The JPEG file path `PhotoCaptureRepository` returned, kept for the same FR-009 retry-without-recapture reason. | Same as above. |
90	
91	No field here is ever written to disk or to the backend as its own record — only a *successful*
92	recognition's resulting text ever becomes part of an `Entry` via `CreateEntryUseCase`.
93	
94	## State transitions (per modality, per research.md R6: "confirming Save" is a different trigger each time)
95	
96	```
97	Modal opens (showModalBottomSheet, fresh InsertionModalBloc)
98	  -> InsertionModalTexto(text: '')                              # FR-002 default tab
99	
100	[Texto tab]
101	  TextDraftChanged(text) -> InsertionModalTexto(text)            # Salvar enabled iff text.trim().isNotEmpty (FR-003)
102	  SaveTextSubmitted (text non-empty, not already in flight)
103	    -> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)
104	        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
105	        CreateEntryUseCase(text, manual)
106	            Right(entry)  -> entry appended to EntriesRepository.cachedEntries -> modal closes (FR-011)
107	            Left(failure) -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)                              (FR-009)
108	
109	[Áudio tab — recording starts the instant the tab becomes active, FR-004]
110	  TabSelected(audio)
111	    -> AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission() == false -> InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied
112	    -> else: AudioCaptureRepository.start() -> InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: 0:00)      # waveform widget subscribes directly to the amplitude stream (research.md R6/contracts)
113	  (timer ticks update `elapsed` only — no network, no recognition yet)
114	  AudioStopRequested
115	    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path
116	    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving()                                                               # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
117	        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010 — checked before transcribing at all, research.md R5)
118	        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path, lang: 'pt')
119	            Left(EmptyRecognitionResult()) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(noSpeechMessage)   (Edge Cases: silence — the repository itself guarantees this, never Right(''))
120	            Left(TranscriptionError())     -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(genericMessage)     (FR-009)
121	            Right(text) -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, audio)
122	                Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingAudioPath cleared; modal closes
123	                Left(failure) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(failure.message)     # audio file still held — RetryRequested re-enters AudioStopRequested's saving branch without a fresh recording
124	  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalAudioFailure, _pendingAudioPath != null)
125	    -> re-run the InsertionModalAudioSaving branch above against the same _pendingAudioPath
126	  TabSelected(<anything else>) while InsertionModalAudioRecording
127	    -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard(); _pendingAudioPath = null; emit the target tab's idle state   (Edge Cases)
128	
129	[Foto tab]
130	  TabSelected(photo) -> InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                                               # two buttons, no image yet (FR-005)
131	  PhotoSourceSelected(camera | gallery)
132	    -> PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)
133	        null (user cancelled the OS picker) -> stays InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                   (Edge Cases/User Story 4)
134	        path -> _pendingImagePath = path; InsertionModalFotoSaving()                                # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
135	            ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
136	            PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(path)
137	                Left(OcrNoTextFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(noTextMessage)   (Edge Cases: illegible/blank image — the repository normalizes a blank-text 200 response to this same failure, never Right(''))
138	                Left(otherFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)
139	                Right(text) [confidence ignored — Clarification 3] -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, photo)
140	                    Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
141	                    Left(failure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)   # image still held — RetryRequested re-enters this branch
142	  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure, _pendingImagePath != null)
143	    -> re-run the recognize+create branch above against the same _pendingImagePath
144	
145	[Any tab, any sub-state] ModalClosed (close button, scrim tap, system back)
146	  -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard() if a recording is in progress; bloc disposed; nothing persisted  (FR-008, User Story 4)
147	```
148	
149	## Backend `Failure` (reused, not redefined) vs. the new local `RecognitionFailure`
150	
151	| Repository | Return type | Why |
152	|---|---|---|
153	| `EntriesRepository.create()` | `Either<Failure, Entry>` | Real network call; reuses F000's closed 13-code hierarchy unchanged. |
154	| `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` | `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` | Real network call to `media-ocr`; `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` already exists in `failure.dart` from F000 and covers the illegible/blank-image Edge Case directly. |
155	| `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` | `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` | On-device only, no network call — `RecognitionFailure` (`emptyResult`\|`transcriptionError`) is a new, small sealed type local to `capture/domain/`, not added to `core/network/failure.dart` (research.md R7). |
156	
157	Three write-endpoint failure scenarios this unit's own `mocktail` tests cover, toward RNF09's
158	running 15-scenario total (`entries-create` and `media-ocr` are two of the spec's five write
159	endpoints):
160	
161	| Endpoint | Scenario | Expected `Failure` |
162	|---|---|---|
163	| `entries-create` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
164	| `media-ocr` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
165	
166	## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)
167	
168	No additions — see research.md R10. Every value the three tabs need (primary/outline/text
169	buttons, text field states, `colorError`, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`,
170	spacing, radii, type scale) already exists from F000/RF03.

| `tags` | `List<EntryTag>` | Always empty for a freshly created entry (tags are the manual-tagging extension, out of scope — requirements.md §2); modeled so later units reading an `Entry` don't need a second type. |
| `piiStatus` | `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; this unit does not branch on it. |
| `piiSpans` | `List<PiiSpan>` | As returned; not rendered by this unit. |
| `embeddingStatus` | `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; not rendered by this unit. |
| `mediaDurationSeconds` | `int?` | This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null` on the response to an entry this unit creates. |
| `serverRevision` | `int` | Opaque; not used by this unit. |
| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | — |
| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | — |

```dart
enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)
enum PiiStatus { pending, clean, flagged, failed }
enum EmbeddingStatus { pending, ready, failed }

class EntryTag { final String id; final String name; }
class PiiSpan { final int start; final int end; final String type; }
```

**Validation rule**: `content` is never sent empty or whitespace-only — enforced before any of the
three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a
recognition failure, not forwarded to entry creation — Edge Cases).

## `EntriesRepository` (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)

```dart
abstract class EntriesRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});
  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;   // FR-011's "local entries store/cache" — in-memory, this process's lifetime
}
```

- `create()` posts to `entries-create` via the existing, unmodified `ApiClient`/`Failure` hierarchy
  — no new `Failure` subtype (every backend error this call can realistically return —
  `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PII_CHECK_FAILED`, `EMBEDDING_FAILED`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`,
  `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `RATE_LIMITED` — already exists in `core/network/failure.dart`).
- `EntriesRepositoryImpl` is registered as a `get_it` `lazySingleton` (the same pattern
  `VaultRepository` uses for its own in-memory, process-lifetime state — RF03 research.md R3) so
  `cachedEntries` survives across modal opens/closes without a local database. On a successful
  `create()`, the returned `Entry` is appended to this in-memory list before the `Either` is
  returned to the caller. Nothing in this unit ever *reads* `cachedEntries` back out for display —
  it exists purely so RF07 (the first unit that reads entries for a screen) has something to read
  from day one, per FR-011's explicit forward reference to "Meus Registros, RF07."

## `CreateEntryUseCase` (`lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart`)

```dart
class CreateEntryUseCase {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source) =>
      repository.create(content: content, source: source);
}
```

The one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry (research.md R8) — `capture`'s
three save usecases below depend on this, never on `EntriesRepository` directly.

## Capture Session (presentation-only state — not a domain entity, not persisted)

Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the
Insertion Modal is open" — in this codebase's existing convention (mirrors RF03's "Presentation-
only state" section: `VaultMode`, the in-progress first PIN entry), this is `InsertionModalBloc`'s
own state plus two bloc-private fields, not a type any other layer sees:

| Held where | What | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| `InsertionModalState` (public, see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's own idle/recording/saving/failure sub-state + the Texto draft text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open; discarded (never persisted) when the modal closes, satisfying FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction — a fresh bloc is created on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. |
| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The WAV file path `AudioCaptureRepository` wrote to, kept only so a failed transcribe-or-save can retry (FR-009) without re-recording. Cleared on successful save, on modal close, or on switching away from the Áudio tab (Edge Cases: switching tabs mid-recording discards it). | Same as above. |
| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The JPEG file path `PhotoCaptureRepository` returned, kept for the same FR-009 retry-without-recapture reason. | Same as above. |

No field here is ever written to disk or to the backend as its own record — only a *successful*
recognition's resulting text ever becomes part of an `Entry` via `CreateEntryUseCase`.

## State transitions (per modality, per research.md R6: "confirming Save" is a different trigger each time)

```
Modal opens (showModalBottomSheet, fresh InsertionModalBloc)
  -> InsertionModalTexto(text: '')                              # FR-002 default tab

[Texto tab]
  TextDraftChanged(text) -> InsertionModalTexto(text)            # Salvar enabled iff text.trim().isNotEmpty (FR-003)
  SaveTextSubmitted (text non-empty, not already in flight)
    -> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
        CreateEntryUseCase(text, manual)
            Right(entry)  -> entry appended to EntriesRepository.cachedEntries -> modal closes (FR-011)
            Left(failure) -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)                              (FR-009)

[Áudio tab — recording starts the instant the tab becomes active, FR-004]
  TabSelected(audio)
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission() == false -> InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied
    -> else: AudioCaptureRepository.start() -> InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: 0:00)      # waveform widget subscribes directly to the amplitude stream (research.md R6/contracts)
  (timer ticks update `elapsed` only — no network, no recognition yet)
  AudioStopRequested
    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path
    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving()                                                               # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010 — checked before transcribing at all, research.md R5)
        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path, lang: 'pt')
            Left(EmptyRecognitionResult()) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(noSpeechMessage)   (Edge Cases: silence — the repository itself guarantees this, never Right(''))
            Left(TranscriptionError())     -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(genericMessage)     (FR-009)
            Right(text) -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, audio)
                Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingAudioPath cleared; modal closes
                Left(failure) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(failure.message)     # audio file still held — RetryRequested re-enters AudioStopRequested's saving branch without a fresh recording
  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalAudioFailure, _pendingAudioPath != null)
    -> re-run the InsertionModalAudioSaving branch above against the same _pendingAudioPath
  TabSelected(<anything else>) while InsertionModalAudioRecording
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard(); _pendingAudioPath = null; emit the target tab's idle state   (Edge Cases)

[Foto tab]
  TabSelected(photo) -> InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                                               # two buttons, no image yet (FR-005)
  PhotoSourceSelected(camera | gallery)
    -> PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)
        null (user cancelled the OS picker) -> stays InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                   (Edge Cases/User Story 4)
        path -> _pendingImagePath = path; InsertionModalFotoSaving()                                # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
            ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
            PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(path)
                Left(OcrNoTextFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(noTextMessage)   (Edge Cases: illegible/blank image — the repository normalizes a blank-text 200 response to this same failure, never Right(''))
                Left(otherFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)
                Right(text) [confidence ignored — Clarification 3] -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, photo)
                    Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
                    Left(failure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)   # image still held — RetryRequested re-enters this branch
  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure, _pendingImagePath != null)
    -> re-run the recognize+create branch above against the same _pendingImagePath

[Any tab, any sub-state] ModalClosed (close button, scrim tap, system back)
  -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard() if a recording is in progress; bloc disposed; nothing persisted  (FR-008, User Story 4)
```

## Backend `Failure` (reused, not redefined) vs. the new local `RecognitionFailure`

| Repository | Return type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `EntriesRepository.create()` | `Either<Failure, Entry>` | Real network call; reuses F000's closed 13-code hierarchy unchanged. |
| `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` | `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` | Real network call to `media-ocr`; `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` already exists in `failure.dart` from F000 and covers the illegible/blank-image Edge Case directly. |
| `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` | `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` | On-device only, no network call — `RecognitionFailure` (`emptyResult`\|`transcriptionError`) is a new, small sealed type local to `capture/domain/`, not added to `core/network/failure.dart` (research.md R7). |

Three write-endpoint failure scenarios this unit's own `mocktail` tests cover, toward RNF09's
running 15-scenario total (`entries-create` and `media-ocr` are two of the spec's five write
endpoints):

| Endpoint | Scenario | Expected `Failure` |
|---|---|---|
| `entries-create` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
| `media-ocr` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |

## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)

No additions — see research.md R10. Every value the three tabs need (primary/outline/text
buttons, text field states, `colorError`, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`,
spacing, radii, type scale) already exists from F000/RF03.

run guide, not an implementation spec — interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in

  recording/picker call.

channel under `flutter_test`)

### Story 1 — Text entry (P1)

1. From Home/Chat, tap "+". **Expect**: the modal rises as an overlay (Home/Chat visible/dimmed
   underneath), Texto tab active, empty field, "Salvar" disabled.
2. Type a short note. **Expect**: "Salvar" becomes enabled the moment the field is non-empty.
3. Tap "Salvar". **Expect**: a brief plain loading indicator if the call takes >300 ms (RNF01),

4. Confirm via a debug log of the request (or a backend-side check) that `POST entries-create` was
   called with `source: "manual"` and the typed content.

### Story 2 — Audio entry (P1)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Áudio". **Expect**: recording starts immediately (no extra tap) — stop
   button, animated waveform, running `mm:ss` timer.

   `expected-transcription.md`.

   re-record (FR-009/SC-004) — confirm by restoring connectivity and tapping retry, which succeeds
   using the same already-recorded audio.

### Story 3 — Photo entry (P2)

2. Tap "Galeria", pick `ocr_fixture_01.png` (or any image with legible text) from the Simulator's
   photo library (seed it via `xcrun simctl addmedia` beforehand if needed). **Expect**: a plain
   loading indicator, then the modal closes.

5. Tap "Câmera" instead and cancel the system camera UI without taking a photo. **Expect**: stays
   on the two-button Captura state, no entry created.

### Story 4 — Abandoning a capture (P3)

1. Type partial text in Texto, tap the modal's close ("x"). **Expect**: no entry created.

- Background the app mid-recording (Simulator: Cmd+Shift+H), then relaunch. **Expect**: cold launch
  re-enters the app's normal routing (splash → vault → Home/Chat); the modal is not reopened in any

1	# Research: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	F000's research.md left "local cache" open generically and named no package for audio/photo
4	capture at all (neither existed as a concern yet); RF03's research.md R1 already set the precedent
5	for how this project treats a package that isn't in Principle II's explicit list but is needed to
6	implement a literal FR. This file resolves every such choice RF01 needs, plus the one structural
7	decision (R8) that reconciles this unit's scope with RF10's forward-looking wording in
8	`requirements.md`.
9	
10	## R1 — Audio recording package
11	
12	- **Decision**: `record` (`AudioRecorder`), configured with `RecordConfig(encoder:
13	  AudioEncoder.wav, sampleRate: 16000, numChannels: 1)`.
14	- **Rationale**: FR-004 needs a start/stop recorder plus a live amplitude signal to drive the
15	  prototype's "animated 12-bar waveform" (prototype-extract.md §2.3); `record` is the de-facto
16	  standard Flutter recording plugin (it backs `waveform_recorder` and similar higher-level widgets)
17	  and exposes both `start`/`stop` and `onAmplitudeChanged(Duration)` directly. Recording straight to
18	  16 kHz mono WAV — rather than the plugin's AAC/`m4a` default — means the file hitting
19	  `whisper_ggml` (R2) never needs its bundled FFmpeg conversion step, matching the exact format of
20	  the backend's own test fixture (`docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav`) and
21	  keeping the record→transcribe path format-deterministic end to end.
22	- **Alternatives considered**: `flutter_sound` — a larger, more general-purpose audio toolkit
23	  (playback, streaming, effects) where this unit only ever needs record+stop+amplitude; rejected as
24	  more surface than the requirement calls for. Recording in the default AAC encoder and relying on
25	  `whisper_ggml`'s bundled FFmpeg to convert — rejected as an avoidable extra step and a dependency
26	  on an implicit, undocumented-in-this-project conversion path when the recorder can just emit the
27	  target format directly.
28	- **Permission handling**: `record`'s own `AudioRecorder.hasPermission()` requests the OS
29	  microphone permission itself (no separate `permission_handler` dependency needed). A `false`
30	  result, or recording start throwing on a since-revoked permission, is what the Audio tab's
31	  permission-denied explanatory message (Edge Cases) reacts to.
32	- **Native project note**: requires `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` —
33	  the App Store requires this string before any mic access is even attempted, mirroring how RF03
34	  added `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` for `local_auth` (research.md R1 there).
35	
36	## R2 — On-device transcription package
37	
38	- **Decision**: `whisper_ggml` (Constitution Principle II — fixed, not a choice), using
39	  `WhisperController.transcribe(model: WhisperModel.tiny, audioPath: ..., lang: 'pt')` against the
40	  WAV file R1 produces. The `ggml-tiny` model (quantized `q5_1` variant preferred for size) ships as
41	  a bundled Flutter asset — copied once, on first use, to a writable app-support directory (via
42	  `path_provider`) because the plugin's native loader needs a filesystem path, not an asset handle —
43	  rather than downloaded over the network on first launch.
44	- **Rationale**: Principle II names `whisper_ggml` outright, so the only open questions are model
45	  size/delivery and language. Bundling the model keeps transcription fully on-device and
46	  network-independent from first launch, consistent with "audio content MUST NEVER be sent to the
47	  backend" (Principle II) and with this unit's own offline-write boundary (R5) — a model that had
48	  to be *downloaded* before the first transcription would make an on-device feature secretly
49	  depend on connectivity, undermining the reason it's on-device at all. `lang: 'pt'` is set
50	  explicitly because every UI string and the backend's fixture audio (`expected-transcription.md`)
51	  are Portuguese, and Whisper's multilingual `tiny` model supports it directly — no language
52	  auto-detection step is needed or wanted here.
53	- **Alternatives considered**: Auto-downloading the model from the package's own CDN on first
54	  launch — rejected per the rationale above. A larger model (`base`/`small`) — rejected as an
55	  unrequested accuracy/size trade-off the spec never asks for; `tiny` is the package's own
56	  documented fast/good-accuracy recommendation and keeps the app bundle smaller.
57	- **Native project note**: `whisper_ggml` documents iOS 15.6+ as its minimum; this project's
58	  current `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` is `15.0` (set by `flutter create`, per F000 research.md R8,
59	  which deliberately left it at the SDK default because nothing until now needed a floor). This
60	  unit raises it to `15.6` across all three build configurations in
61	  `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` — a package-forced native change in the same category as
62	  RF03's `Info.plist` addition, not a product decision.
63	
64	## R3 — Photo capture package
65	
66	- **Decision**: `image_picker`, called as `pickImage(source: ImageSource.camera | ImageSource.gallery,
67	  imageQuality: 90)` for both of the Foto tab's two buttons. The non-null `imageQuality` is a
68	  deliberate choice beyond "a reasonable compression value": it forces the plugin's iOS
69	  implementation through its JPEG re-encoding path regardless of the source asset's original
70	  format, which is what makes `mimeType: image/jpeg` always correct for the backend call (R4) even
71	  for the common case of an iOS Photos-library image stored as HEIC — a format `POST /media/ocr`'s
72	  contract does not accept at all (R4).
73	- **Rationale**: FR-005 requires exactly the camera-or-gallery choice the prototype's "Captura"
74	  state shows (two large buttons); `image_picker` is the official Flutter-team plugin for this,
75	  already the de-facto standard, and returns a plain `XFile` (a file path) either way — no
76	  source-specific branching needed past the initial `ImageSource` argument.
77	- **Alternatives considered**: Picking without `imageQuality` and inspecting/transcoding HEIC
78	  output manually (e.g. via the `image` package) — rejected as strictly more code to reach the same
79	  guaranteed-JPEG outcome `imageQuality` already gives for free as a side effect of the plugin's own
80	  documented compression behavior.
81	- **Native project note**: requires `NSCameraUsageDescription` (camera button) and
82	  `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` (gallery button) in `Info.plist`, same category as R1's
83	  microphone string.
84	
85	## R4 — Backend OCR call shape
86	
87	- **Decision**: `PhotoRecognitionRepository` base64-encodes the JPEG bytes R3 produces
88	  (`base64Encode` from `dart:convert`, no new package) and calls `media-ocr`
89	  (`POST /media/ocr`) with `{"image": "<base64>", "mimeType": "image/jpeg"}`, reusing `ApiClient`
90	  unmodified. The response's `confidence` field is read into the result but never branched on
91	  (spec.md Clarifications: confidence-based gating is explicitly RF02's concern).
92	- **Rationale**: `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/media/ocr` schema requires `image`
93	  (a string) and `mimeType` (enum `image/jpeg`/`image/png`/`image/webp` only — no HEIC) with no
94	  separate multipart path; R3's `imageQuality` choice is what guarantees the app only ever sends
95	  one of the three accepted MIME types.
96	- **Alternatives considered**: None — the request shape is dictated entirely by the frozen
97	  contract (Principle III); the only real decision here was R3's upstream format guarantee.
98	
99	## R5 — Blocking Save while offline (FR-010)
100	
101	- **Decision**: A new `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart` (`ConnectivityChecker`, wrapping
102	  `connectivity_plus`'s `Connectivity().checkConnectivity()`) exposes a plain `Future<bool>
103	  hasConnection()` — true unless the result is `ConnectivityResult.none`. Every Save path (text,
104	  audio, photo) checks this *first*, before any transcription/OCR/entry-creation work, and if it is
105	  `false`, fails immediately with `NetworkOfflineFailure` without calling `ApiClient` at all.
106	- **Rationale**: FR-010/SC-005 and the Edge Cases explicitly want the block to happen "without
107	  attempting a network call that cannot succeed" — a reactive catch of `ApiClient`'s own
108	  `NetworkOfflineFailure` (which already exists and already fires on a real failed call) would
109	  satisfy the *error-handling* half of RNF09 but not this specific "don't even try" requirement, so
110	  a proactive, synchronous-feeling pre-check is needed in addition. Checking before transcription
111	  too (not just before the `entries-create` call) gives the snappier "blocked immediately" behavior
112	  FR-010 asks for, and avoids running on-device Whisper inference or an OCR round-trip for a save
113	  that cannot complete regardless. `connectivity_plus` lives in `core/` (not inside the `capture`
114	  feature) because it is the same cross-cutting, interface-level connectivity concern
115	  spec.md's own Assumptions say "already established elsewhere in the product (chat, search)" —
116	  later units (RF04, RF06) blocking their own writes/sends while offline will reuse this exact
117	  checker rather than each growing its own.
118	- **Known limitation, accepted**: `connectivity_plus` reports OS-level interface state (Wi-Fi/
119	  cellular/none), not actual internet reachability — a device on Wi-Fi with no upstream internet
120	  still reads as "connected." Adding a live reachability probe (e.g. pinging the backend) would be
121	  disproportionate machinery for a check whose whole purpose is to avoid an extra network round
122	  trip; the existing reactive `NetworkOfflineFailure` path (R-nothing-new) still catches that
123	  residual case when the real `entries-create` call is attempted.
124	- **Alternatives considered**: Relying solely on `ApiClient`'s existing reactive mapping — rejected
125	  per the "without attempting a network call" wording above. A full reachability ping before every
126	  save — rejected as disproportionate for the stated requirement.
127	
128	## R6 — "Confirming Save" is a different user action per modality
129	
130	- **Decision**: There is no second, explicit "Salvar" tap for the Áudio or Foto tabs. Per spec.md's
131	  own Acceptance Scenarios: for **Texto**, "confirming Save" is the user tapping the tab's "Salvar"
132	  button (User Story 1, FR-003). For **Áudio**, it is the user tapping the stop control (User Story
133	  2 Scenario 2: "the user taps stop... the system automatically transcribes it and completes the
134	  save"). For **Foto**, it is the picker returning a selected/captured image (User Story 3 Scenario
135	  2: "that image is provided... the system automatically extracts its text and completes the
136	  save"). None of the three needs or gets an intermediate editable-text review screen with its own
137	  "Salvar" button — that reviewable state (prototype's "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido") is exactly what
138	  spec.md's Clarification 1 reserves for RF02.
139	- **Rationale**: Re-building a second confirmation tap for audio/photo would recreate the
140	  editable-review step FR-007 explicitly forbids, and would contradict the Acceptance Scenarios'
141	  own wording ("completes the save" as the direct, same-step outcome of stopping/providing — not a
142	  precursor to a later explicit save action). This is the detail most likely to be
143	  over-engineered by accident during implementation, so it is called out here explicitly rather
144	  than left implicit in data-model.md's transition tables alone.
145	- **Alternatives considered**: Adding a plain (non-RF02-styled) "Salvar" button after recognition
146	  succeeds, before creating the entry — rejected: it would be an invented intermediate step with no
147	  basis in the Acceptance Scenarios, and would reintroduce exactly the kind of extra tap SC-003
148	  ("no required intermediate screens") argues against.
149	
150	## R7 — Local recognition failures are not backend `Failure`s
151	
152	- **Decision**: `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(...)` returns
153	  `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>`, where `RecognitionFailure` is a small new sealed type local
154	  to the `capture` feature's domain layer (`emptyResult | transcriptionError`) — **not** a new
155	  subtype added to `core/network/failure.dart`. `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(...)`, by
156	  contrast, *does* return `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` using the existing, unmodified `Failure`
157	  hierarchy, because it is a real network call to `media-ocr` and the backend's closed taxonomy
158	  already has the exact code this path needs (`OcrNoTextFailure` / `OCR_NO_TEXT`, already present in
159	  `failure.dart` since F000).
160	- **Rationale**: This mirrors RF03's research.md R5 precedent exactly: `core/network/failure.dart`
161	  is scoped to the backend's 13-code closed taxonomy (a *server* response can say
162	  `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`; it cannot say "the microphone recording was silent"). On-device Whisper
163	  returning an empty/whitespace transcript, or throwing internally, is a purely local condition
164	  with no corresponding backend code — forcing it through `Either<Failure, T>` would mean either
165	  inventing a fake backend-shaped code for something the backend never sees, or diluting the
166	  "closed" taxonomy's scope. OCR, conversely, is a real backend round trip whose own contract
167	  already names this exact failure mode — no new type needed there at all.
168	- **Alternatives considered**: One shared `Either<Failure, T>` surface for both audio and photo
169	  recognition, adding a new local-only `Failure` subtype for the audio case — rejected for the same
170	  reason RF03 rejected modeling PIN/biometric outcomes that way: it would grow a taxonomy the
171	  spec and RNF09 treat as backend-defined with a code no network response will ever actually send.
172	
173	## R8 — A shared entry-creation seam, because RF10 already names it
174	
175	- **Decision**: `Entry` (full response shape), `EntriesRepository` (create today; later units add
176	  list/search), and a new `CreateEntryUseCase(content, source)` all live in a new, dedicated
177	  `lib/features/entries/` feature — separate from `lib/features/capture/`, which owns only the
178	  Insertion Modal UI and the audio/photo recognition pipeline. This unit's three save usecases
179	  (`SaveTextEntryUseCase`/`SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase`, living in `capture/domain/`)
180	  each depend on `CreateEntryUseCase` from `entries/domain/`, never on `EntriesRepository` or any
181	  `entries/data/` class directly.
182	- **Rationale**: `requirements.md` §RF10 says, verbatim, "The chat feature triggers the creation of
183	  the entry through a shared interface / use case, never by directly importing a repository or data
184	  source **of the entries feature** — a violation here also breaks RNF06." That sentence names "the
185	  entries feature" as something that already exists by the time RF10 is built, and prescribes the
186	  exact shape of how another feature is allowed to reach it (a shared usecase, not its repository).
187	  RF01 is the unit that actually creates that feature for the first time — building `entries/` now,
188	  with exactly the seam RF10's own requirement text describes, means RF10 (and RF07, which also
189	  reads `entries/domain` types) never has to retrofit this boundary later or reach into `capture/`'s
190	  internals. `Entry` is modeled against the *entire* `entries-create` response schema (`id`,
191	  `content`, `source`, `chatMessageId`, `occurredAt`, `tags`, `piiStatus`, `piiSpans`,
192	  `embeddingStatus`, `mediaDurationSeconds`, `serverRevision`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`) rather than
193	  only the fields this unit reads, because every one of those fields is `required` in the frozen
194	  response the backend *always* sends — this is faithfully representing today's contract, not
195	  speculative modeling of a future requirement.
196	- **What this unit does NOT add**: `EntrySource` is defined with exactly the three values this
197	  unit uses (`manual`, `audio`, `photo`) — not `chat`. `CreateEntryUseCase.call()` takes only
198	  `(content, source)` — no `chatMessageId` parameter. Both are left for RF10 to add additively when
199	  it arrives (FR-012: this unit must not implement RF10's behavior); what RF01 commits to is only
200	  that RF10 will *extend* this one usecase rather than invent a second path into `EntriesRepository`.
201	- **Alternatives considered**: Putting `EntriesRepository`/`Entry` inside `capture/` (since RF01 is
202	  the only unit using them so far) — rejected, directly contradicts RF10's "entries feature" wording
203	  and would force a disruptive move later. Having `capture/`'s save usecases call
204	  `EntriesRepository.create()` directly, with `CreateEntryUseCase` deferred to whenever RF10 is
205	  built — rejected: RF10's requirement explicitly bans exactly this shape ("never... directly
206	  importing a repository... of the entries feature"), and building the usecase now costs nothing
207	  extra since RF01 needs the same orchestration either way.
208	
209	## R9 — The "+" button does not exist yet
210	
211	- **Decision**: `HomeChatShellPage`'s `_ComposerBar` (`lib/features/home/presentation/pages/
212	  home_chat_shell_page.dart`) gains a real, enabled leading icon button that opens the Insertion
213	  Modal via `showModalBottomSheet`. Nothing else in the composer (text field, send icon) changes —
214	  both stay disabled, exactly as F000 research.md R10 left them, since RF04 (chat sending) remains
215	  out of scope here.
216	- **Rationale**: F000's own research.md R10 explicitly scoped the composer as "rendered but fully
217	  **disabled**... no RF04 wiring," with no mention of a "+" affordance at all — confirmed by reading
218	  the current file, which has only a `TextField` and a send `IconButton`. FR-001 requires the modal
219	  to be "opened by the '+' button on Home/Chat," so this unit is the one that must add it; a plain
220	  `IconButton` in the composer `Row`, wired only to open the modal, is the minimal change that
221	  satisfies FR-001 without touching the still-disabled text field/send icon next to it.
222	- **Alternatives considered**: A floating action button overlaying the chat area instead of a
223	  composer-bar icon — rejected, the prototype's own composer description (prototype-extract.md
